title: Proof of the locality / non-locality reconciliation
html: (1) Markov locality. Part (1) of the proposition is the definition of the Markov trace. By Jones–Markov trace, the unique R-linear trace \mathrm{tr}_M \colon \bigcup_n H_n(R, q) \to R\otimes\mathbb{Q} satisfying normalisation \mathrm{tr}_M(1) = 1, the trace property \mathrm{tr}_M(ab) = \mathrm{tr}_M(ba), and the Markov property \mathrm{tr}_M(x \sigma_n) = z\, \mathrm{tr}_M(x) for all x \in H_n(R, q), n \geq 1, z = q^3/(q^2+1) (see Primitive Markov-trace axioms); the negative stabilisation \mathrm{tr}_M(x \sigma_n^{-1}) = z_{-}\, \mathrm{tr}_M(x), z_{-} = z - (q - q^{-1}), follows from the Hecke quadratic relation. The Markov property is the locality statement. \square
